name: airport-access-map
description: Zero-cost static disaster transport map for international gateway airports across Japan.

scripts.build:demo: npm run sample:generate && npm run sample:validate && VITE_SAMPLE_DEMO=true VITE_PUBLIC_BASE=/demo/airport-access/ vite build && node scripts/prepare-demo-entry.js
scripts.build:pages: npm run sample:generate && npm run sample:validate && VITE_SAMPLE_DEMO=true VITE_PUBLIC_BASE=/airport-access-map/ vite build && node scripts/prepare-demo-entry.js
scripts.verify:oss: npm run validate:publication && npm run validate:sources && npm run validate:network && npm run sample:generate && npm run sample:validate && npm test && npm run build:pages
